mechanism_narrative: A further decline in TRANSIT below its current depressed level signals weaker city-center visitation, which will reduce discretionary retail footfall and pull RETAIL_REC lower within one week and persist for up to four weeks.

failure_condition: RETAIL_REC declines over the next 14 days despite PARKS remaining below -30 throughout the forecast window.
